traceability.notes:
All specified acceptance criteria for docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md are met.
• Before/After/Mixed JSDoc Tags: Implemented via processCommentLine + isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine and covered by explicit tests for traceability before, after, and interleaved with @param/@returns. • Proper Termination & JSDoc Tag Detection: isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine detects any `@word` tag other than @story/@req/@supports; processCommentLine finalizes the pending annotation when such a line appears, stopping value accumulation at the correct boundary. • Continuation Logic & Preserve Multiline: Continuation is only applied when there is a pending annotation and the normalized line is non-empty and not a JSDoc tag; multiline story example for the 022 story confirms values are preserved correctly. • No False Positives & Error Messages: The previously problematic case (JSDoc tags concatenated into IDs) now passes as valid; existing invalid-format tests still enforce clear, specific messages, and the Jest run shows no regressions. • Backward Compatibility: The entire valid-annotation-format test suite for earlier stories (005.0, 007.0, 010.1, 010.2) passes unchanged. • Documentation & Tests: Rule docs explicitly describe JSDoc coexistence, including an example referencing the 022 story, and tests for this story’s REQ IDs are present and passing.
Based on concrete code, documentation, and passing, story-tagged tests, the specification is fully implemented.
